name: spec-lint-tier-e2e-spawn-count
body: `spec_lint_tier_scopes_requirements_violations` spawns the candidate binary eight times per run — four complete-model scopes plus four broken-model scopes — each a real process that re-reads the layers tree. Upgrade to fewer invocations (or a shared multi-scope invocation) if lint startup latency ever dominates the e2e tier.
